correctness.rationale: With N≥2, 0<r<N, a* strictly between α and β and every ε>0, the binary-entropy function V=K(x*||x)+δ S_N(x*) K(t*||t)/[ε(1+u)] is proper on the open rectangle. Direct differentiation gives Vdot=δa(x−x*)[S_N(x)−S_N(x*)]/ε≤0 and equality only on x=x*. The vector field crosses that line unless a=a*, so LaSalle gives interior global attraction and excludes interior recurrence. Independent exact-rational evaluation at a non-equilibrium state verified the cross-term cancellation; finite ODE plots are not the proof.

evidence: October result also gives exact integrated dissipation and L2 control; November result also gives the discriminant/node-focus boundary.
